subject: Preliminary Notice: Cedar Ridge Townhomes
body:
PRELIMINARY NOTICE. Pursuant to state law, this is a preliminary notice that the undersigned has furnished labor and materials to the above project, Cedar Ridge Townhomes, Lots 1 through 8. This is not a lien. It is a notice required to preserve lien rights.

The direct contractor is requested to furnish the name and address of the construction lender and any payment bond surety within 20 days of receipt of this notice.

Ridgeline Electric, Office Manager
note: Boilerplate that says it is not a lien, from a sub already on the job. It still starts a 20-day window, counted from the day it arrived.

subject: Inspection scheduled: Permit 26-1893, framing
body: Your framing inspection for permit 26-1893 is confirmed, morning window. Ensure the site is accessible and the approved plans and permit card are on site by Wednesday, September 23. Inspections not ready at arrival are charged a reinspection fee.
note: Readiness by a date is a clock. Two days out, so urgent on the calendar alone.

subject: CO-2604-07: kitchen island upgrade, and the lender walk
body:
We'd like to proceed with the upgraded island on units 3 to 6 as priced. Please send CO-2604-07 for signature; we need to lock this before cabinets are released.

Separately, can someone from your team meet the lender's inspector at units 1 and 2 later this week? He asked me for a contact.
note: Two asks in one mail: a change order in the register and an owner request for a site contact. Cabinet release on Sep 30 waits on change orders and falls on the CO's own approval date, so the schedule makes it urgent.

subject: Bid: Harbor View mixed-use, plumbing scope
body: Attached is our bid for the Harbor View plumbing scope per the 8/28 drawings and addenda 1 and 2. Excludes fire protection and site utilities past 5 feet. Valid 30 days.
note: A sub's quote on a live pursuit. It does not name the bid log entry, so no clock runs from it and it is high until the estimator ties it in.

subject: Invoice 90211: roofing, 5th Street
body: Invoice 90211 attached for shingles, ice and water shield and underlayment delivered to 5th Street on Sep 15. PO 5TH-044. Terms net 30.

subject: Rain Thursday
body: Forecast is 80% rain Thursday. Moving the 5th Street slab pour to Friday unless anyone objects. I'll call Precision this afternoon.

subject: Walkthrough photos?
body: Any chance you can send the photos from last week's walkthrough? Our lender is asking for them with the draw request.

subject: Stop losing money on change orders
body: Contractors using Keystake recover 12% more on change orders. See how in 15 minutes. Book a demo with our team.

subject: Request for information: complaint 2026-7741
body: This office received a complaint alleging inadequate fall protection at your jobsite at 5th Street. We have not conducted an inspection at this time. Please respond in writing within 5 working days describing the conditions and any corrective action taken, with supporting photographs.
note: A safety regulator's letter, not a building inspection, but it is a compliance notice from an authority about the site, so the inspection class holds it. Working days count past the weekend.

subject: Friday pour crew
body: Confirming a six-person crew Friday 6am for the 5th Street slab on grade, pump truck on site at 5:30. Let us know if the date moves after the weather call.

subject: Question before I sign CO-2607-03
body: Before I sign CO-2607-03 for the exam room 6 sink, can you break out the plumber's labor from the fixture and trim? Our operations director wants to see it separately.

subject: Pricing request: card reader and data drops
body: We would like pricing to add a card reader at the staff entrance and two more data drops in exam 4. Can you get us a number with any schedule impact?
note: A new change request, not in the register yet, so it is high until it is logged.

subject: Added soffit at corridor, change request
body: The added soffit at the main corridor shown on ASI-3 was not on the bid drawings. Our pricing is attached: $4,860 for framing, board and finish. Please issue a subcontract change order before we build it.
note: A sub's own change request is a change order, not sub correspondence.

from: Tom Becker, Lakeshore Community Credit Union
subject: CO-2612-01 canopy relocation
body: Good news, the board approved the canopy relocation this morning. The signed CO-2612-01 will come over from our CFO on Monday.
note: An open register item: the approval window runs until the signed copy is in. Mike is both the lead on Lakeshore and the owner.

from: Tom Becker, Lakeshore Community Credit Union
subject: Vault sleeve pricing
body: Where are we on pricing for CO-2612-02, the night deposit vault sleeve? Our facilities committee meets on the 29th and I'd like it in their packet.

subject: CCD-02: relocate nurse call annunciator, 5th Street
body: Construction Change Directive 02 is attached, issued with the owner's authorization. Relocate the nurse call annunciator from the corridor to the staff work room per the attached sketch SK-E-07. Proceed on a time and material basis. Submit your pricing within 10 days of this directive.

subject: CO-2604-06 vs pay app
body: Our accountant says the executed amount on CO-2604-06 for the tile does not match what came through on the last pay application. Can someone reconcile?
note: Names a change order the register shows as executed and closed: no window runs, and naming it means it is logged, so not high. It arrives from the 5th Street owner but the CO number ties it to Cedar Ridge.

subject: Thanks for Thursday
body: Thanks for walking us through the old footing you found at grid B, and for the photos. The board is fine with you pricing the removal. Per the general conditions your number is due within 14 days of the owner's notice, so if you can hit that it goes on the October draw. Great work by Dave's crew this week.
note: A thank-you note that sets a 14-day pricing window on a concealed condition. The clock is in the middle of the pleasantries.

subject: CO-2604-08 hose bibs
body: Are we doing the added hose bibs on CO-2604-08 or not? We need blocking in before we close up the east walls at buildings 3 and 4.
note: The pricing is not due until Oct 9, but cabinet release on Sep 30 waits on change orders: urgent from the schedule, not the calendar.

from: Tom Becker, Lakeshore Community Credit Union
subject: Delete second ATM island
body: After the member survey we want to drop the second ATM island at the drive-up. Please send us a deduct change order for that scope.

subject: Pendant circuits at Cedar Ridge kitchens
body: The owner's lighting selections added 14 pendant circuits across units 3 to 6. T&M tickets signed by your super are attached. Please write this up as a change so we can bill it.

subject: Invitation to Bid: PHUSD-2026-14 Pine Hollow Elementary Modernization
body: The Pine Hollow Unified School District invites sealed bids for Project PHUSD-2026-14, Pine Hollow Elementary Modernization. Bids are due by October 8 at 2:00 pm at the District Office. A mandatory pre-bid site walk is Thursday, September 24 at 9:00 am; bids from firms not on the sign-in sheet will be rejected. Bid security of 10% is required.
note: A public bid date is a real clock. The mandatory walk on Sep 24 comes first and waits on the estimator, so it is urgent.

subject: PHUSD-2026-14 Addendum No. 2
body: Addendum No. 2 is posted to the planroom. It revises the roof replacement scope at Building C and adds unit prices for dry rot repair. The bid date is unchanged. Bidder questions must be submitted in writing no later than September 29.
note: The question cutoff is the clock here, not the bid date.

subject: Harbor View Mixed-Use: Addendum 3
body: Addendum 3 is posted. It revises the post-tensioned deck at level 2 and adds a bid alternate for the rooftop amenity deck. The bid date is unchanged.

subject: Pine Hollow masonry number
body: Our number for the Pine Hollow masonry scope is $212,400. Includes CMU infill at the new classroom wing and brick repair per the survey. Excludes bond and winter protection.

subject: Harbor View storefront and curtain wall quote
body: Quote attached for the Harbor View storefront and the level 1 curtain wall. Aluminum pricing is held through October 30. Lead time is 14 weeks from approved shops.
note: From the Lakeshore storefront supplier, but the quote is for the Harbor View bid, so it is a bid item.

subject: Performance bond on the GMP
body: Our lender has asked that every bidder carry a performance and payment bond on the GMP. Please confirm you can provide one and include the rate as a separate line.
note: The owner of a project still being bid. It reads like owner correspondence, but a prospective owner's question about the bid is a bid item.

subject: Harbor View planholders list
body: Hi all, the updated planholders list for Harbor View is attached, thanks for registering. Housekeeping: the bidder question period closes within 5 business days of this note, and after that we will not issue further clarifications. Parking for the site walk was fine last time, so same arrangement.
note: A routine planholders note with the question cutoff tucked into housekeeping. Business days skip the weekend.

subject: 14 new public bids match your profile
body: New this week: 14 public projects in your area, including Pine Hollow Elementary Modernization. Premium members see plan holders and bid results. Upgrade before Friday and take 20% off your first year.
note: A bid-lead service naming a real pursuit, with a date in it. It is a pitch; the date is a sales deadline.

subject: Electrical bid, BID-26-044 Harbor View
body: Electrical bid for your package BID-26-044 attached, base bid plus alternates 1 and 2. Switchgear pricing is from the manufacturer's quote dated 9/15.
note: Names the open bid log entry, so the bid's due date governs. The internal estimate review on Sep 29 waits on sub numbers.

subject: Harbor View interviews
body: We plan to interview the three lowest bidders after bids open. Could your team present on the morning of the 7th? Please bring your proposed superintendent.

subject: Invitation to Bid: Ferris Park restroom building
body: Marlow County Parks invites bids for a new restroom building at Ferris Park, approximately 900 square feet, masonry bearing walls. Bids due October 15 at 2:00 pm. Plans are available from the county planroom.
note: A new invitation, not in the bid log yet, with its own bid date more than ten days out.

subject: Inspection result: FAILED, BP-26-1140 underground plumbing
body: Inspection result for permit BP-26-1140: FAILED. Underground plumbing. Items: 1) test not holding at 10 psi, 2) cleanout at grid 3 not accessible. Reinspection must be requested within 10 days or the inspection record will be flagged for review.

subject: Inspection result: APPROVED, permit 26-1893 rough electrical
body: Inspection result for permit 26-1893: APPROVED. Rough electrical, all areas. Inspector: R. Salas.

subject: Cylinder breaks, 5th Street footings
body: 7-day cylinder breaks for the 5th Street footing pour of 9/8: 3,120 psi average against a 4,000 psi design. On track for 28 days. Full report attached.

subject: IVR confirmation 44817: BP-26-0771 insulation
body: IVR confirmation 44817. Permit BP-26-0771, Building 3 insulation, AM route. Have the site ready and the permit card posted by Tuesday, September 22. Cancellations must be made through the IVR.

subject: Hydrostatic test witnessed: 5th Street
body: The fire sprinkler hydrostatic test at 5th Street was witnessed today and passed. Final fire inspection may be requested once the alarm monitoring certificate is on file.

subject: Notice of violation: erosion control, BP-26-1140
body: A site visit found sediment leaving the Lakeshore site at the east curb inlet and a failed silt fence along the north line. Correct the deficiencies within 72 hours of this notice. Failure to correct may result in a stop work order.
note: A real window stated in hours, which the parser does not read. The right outcome is Mike setting the date by hand; code must not guess it.

subject: Structural observation, Cedar Ridge building 2
body: Hi Dave, good visit yesterday, the crew had everything open for us. Report attached. Two items at the stair stringers need correction. The engineer of record asks that they be corrected and re-observed within 7 days, before sheathing covers them. Otherwise all looks tidy.
note: A friendly report from the special inspector with a correction window inside it. The sender's contact is the 5th Street job, but the text names Cedar Ridge.

subject: Request received: BP-26-0771 building 4 framing
body: Your inspection request for permit BP-26-0771, Building 4 framing, has been received and is pending inspector assignment. You will receive a confirmation with the inspection window.

from: Tom Becker, Lakeshore Community Credit Union
subject: Fwd: fire lane striping
body:
Mike, this came to us as the property owner rather than to you.

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: City of Easton Fire Prevention
The fire lane striping and signage at the Lakeshore branch must be complete before the final fire inspection. The inspector will verify it on site; please have it complete by October 2.
note: An authority's notice that arrives through the owner. The class follows the notice, not the sender, and a dated inspection matter is never below high.

subject: Lakeshore storefront delivery
body: Bad news on the Lakeshore storefront: the extrusion mill is behind, and frames now ship October 9 for delivery October 12 at the earliest. To hold even that date we need your release on the revised shop drawings no later than September 25.
note: A delivery delay that carries a real release date. The storefront install on Oct 5 is already missed, but it falls after the release date, so the calendar sets the priority.

subject: Board staged at 5th Street
body: Board is staged on level 1. Crew can start hanging Thursday if the framing inspection passes; let me know the result as soon as you have it.

subject: Updated COI
body: Updated certificate of insurance attached, Brightwater named as additional insured. Our GL renewed on 9/15.

subject: August pay app, Cedar Ridge
body: We are still waiting on payment for our August pay app on Cedar Ridge. It has been 45 days. Can someone tell me where it is?
note: A sub chasing payment, not the bill itself. Said to be a repeat, so high.

subject: Conditional waiver, August progress
body: Conditional waiver for the August progress payment on 5th Street attached. Please send over the unconditional form when the check clears and we will sign it the same day.

subject: Backcharge, sink rough-in at 5th Street
body: We received your backcharge for the damaged sink rough-in at 5th Street. We dispute it. Our crew was not on site the week of 9/7, and the damage is at a wall the drywall crew had already boarded.
note: The sender's contact row is the Harbor View bid, but the text names 5th Street.

subject: Notice of Intent to Lien: Cedar Ridge Townhomes
body: NOTICE OF INTENT TO LIEN. Gulfline Insulation furnished spray foam insulation to Cedar Ridge Townhomes under contract with Oakline Framing. The balance of $9,340 remains unpaid. Unless payment is received within 10 days of this notice, a claim of lien will be recorded against the property.

subject: Truss delivery, Cedar Ridge building 4
body: Truss delivery for building 4 is pushed to next Tuesday. The plant lost a day to a saw breakdown. Sorry for the shuffle.

subject: Pump for the 5th Street walls
body: Happy to hold the pump for the wall pours, no problem. One thing: our quoted price on the remaining 5th Street pours holds only if we get your PO within 5 business days, after that the plant's October increase applies. Thanks as always.
note: A friendly scheduling note with a price hold expiring inside it: a real cost clock, disguised.

subject: Siding drop, Cedar Ridge building 5
body: We can drop the siding for Cedar Ridge building 5 any morning before Friday. Just tell us which day works for your crew.
note: Known gap: a supplier offering delivery slots. 'Before Friday' parses as a date and sub correspondence can carry real clocks, so code flags a clock and raises it to high. The labels say no clock.

subject: Pay app 6, line 9
body: On pay app 6, line 9 shows HVAC at 80% complete, but the ductwork is not in the exam rooms yet. Can you walk me through how that was measured?

from: Tom Becker, Lakeshore Community Credit Union
subject: Updated schedule
body: Can we get an updated schedule? Our marketing team would like to announce an opening month for the branch.

subject: Re: Re: Unit 2 punch list
body: Following up on the punch items from the walk on the 9th. The buyer for unit 2 is getting anxious and our sales office keeps asking me.

subject: Draw inspection, Cedar Ridge
body: I have the draw inspection for Cedar Ridge on my calendar for Thursday. Please have your superintendent available and the stored materials invoices on hand for the trusses and windows.
note: Called an inspection, but a lender's draw inspector works for the owner. Not a building department and no response clock.

subject: Retainage
body: Our lender will release half of retainage at substantial completion. What date are you targeting, so I can give them a heads up?

from: Tom Becker, Lakeshore Community Credit Union
subject: Drive-up lanes
body: Second time asking: when will the drive-up lanes be usable? Members keep asking our tellers.

subject: Our imaging tenant
body: Heads up on our side: the imaging group's lease lets them walk away if they cannot move in by November 20. I know that is not in your contract, but it is why I keep asking about the elevator.
note: Known gap: the owner's own lease date, which she says is not in the contract. It is not the firm's clock, but a dated phrase parses and owner mail can carry real clocks, so code raises an alert.

subject: Dumpster at building 4
body: The dumpster at building 4 is overflowing again and the HOA next door sent us photos. Can you get it swapped?
note: An owner complaint she says is a repeat: high.

subject: Thanks for the gate
body: Thanks for the quick turnaround on the entry gate, the residents noticed. Please take this as our written notice under 14.2 for the siding damage at building 1 from the lift last week. The contract asks that it be corrected within 10 days of notice. Otherwise things look great out there.
note: A formal notice to cure inside a thank-you email.

subject: Pay app 6 returned
body: Pay app 6 is returned unapproved: the lien waivers from Hartley and Metro are missing. Please resubmit with waivers by September 25 so it makes this month's draw.
note: A resubmission date on the firm's own pay application is the firm's clock.

subject: Invoice R-55812
body: Invoice R-55812: 60 ft articulating boom lift, 5th Street, 28-day cycle ending 9/18. Delivery and pickup included. Auto-pay not on file.

subject: Pay application 3, 5th Street
body: Pay application 3 for 5th Street attached: $38,200 this period less 10% retainage, with the conditional waiver.

subject: Invoice 4471: site services, September
body: Invoice 4471 for September site services at Cedar Ridge: 3 portable restrooms, weekly service, 1 hand wash station.

subject: Statement: account 20877
body: Statement enclosed. Invoice 77310 is 45 days past due. Please remit to avoid a credit hold on your account.
note: From the accounts receivable address, which is not the job contact on file, and names no job.

subject: Annual renewal invoice
body: Your annual renewal invoice for 3 estimating seats is attached, $2,970. Payment is due by October 1 to avoid an interruption in service.
note: A real bill for software the firm uses, with a due date on it. A date on a bill is a payment term, not a response clock.

subject: INVOICE: Annual contractor directory listing
body: INVOICE 2026-8812. Annual contractor directory listing: $495.00. THIS IS NOT A BILL. THIS IS A SOLICITATION. You are under no obligation to pay unless you accept this offer.
note: Dressed as an invoice, says it is a solicitation.

subject: Credit memo CM-1182
body: Credit memo CM-1182 attached for 12 bundles returned from the 5th Street job. Apply against invoice 90211.

subject: September pay app, and the transformer
body:
September pay app for Cedar Ridge is attached, with our conditional waiver.

Also, we cannot energize building 3 until the utility sets the transformer. Who on your side is talking to the utility? Our crew is ready.
note: Two topics: a pay application for AP and a field question for the project manager.

subject: Invoice 2026-311
body: Invoice 2026-311 for August testing and special inspection services at 5th Street: 6 site visits, cylinder testing, 2 reports.

subject: OSHA 30 courses for your crew
body: Group rates on OSHA 30 and fall protection certification this fall. Onsite or online. Reply for a quote for your team.

subject: 0% financing on compact track loaders
body: Compact track loaders at 0% for 48 months, through the end of September only. Stop by the yard for a demo.

subject: Experienced superintendents available now
body: We have three commercial superintendents available immediately, OSHA and CPR certified. Our placement fee is 18%. Want resumes?

subject: Webinar: surviving the retainage squeeze
body: Join our free webinar Thursday at 1 pm: how mid-size contractors are getting retainage released faster. Seats are limited.

subject: 10 commercial bid invites a month
body: We help general contractors get 10 or more commercial bid invitations every month. Want to see how on a quick call?

subject: You've been nominated
body: Congratulations! Brightwater Builders has been nominated for the 2026 Regional Builder Excellence Awards. Confirm your entry and pay the $350 entry fee before October 2 to be included in the program.
note: Flattering, with a deadline. The date is the vendor's sales calendar, not a clock.

subject: Drone progress photos
body: Monthly drone progress photos for your jobs, delivered in 24 hours. Owners and lenders love them. First flight free.

subject: NOTICE: Contractor license record update required
body: NOTICE OF LICENSE RECORD COMPLIANCE. Our review indicates your contractor records may require updating. Respond within 30 days to avoid a lapse in your compliance profile. Contractor Compliance Services is a private company and is not affiliated with any state agency.
note: Dressed as a regulatory notice with a window. The small print says it is a private company selling a service.

subject: Your field schedule, finally in one place
body: Crewboard puts every sub, delivery and inspection on one board your whole team can see. Free for 30 days.

subject: Workers comp audit coming?
body: Contractors like you overpay on workers comp by 20% on average. Let us review your class codes before your next audit.

subject: Fall contractor appreciation day
body: Join us at the yard Saturday for our fall contractor appreciation day: lunch, demos, and 5% off composite decking all weekend.
note: From a supplier on an active job, but a promotion, not correspondence about the work.

subject: Following up: AI takeoffs
body: Following up on my last note. Our new AI takeoff reads a full plan set in minutes. Can I show you on a 15-minute call?
note: A sales follow-up from a vendor the firm already pays for another product. Repeat words do not raise a pitch.

subject: Safety meeting Monday
body: Safety meeting Monday 7 am at the Cedar Ridge trailer, everyone including Ken. Topic is ladder use after last week's near miss.

subject: Check run this week
body: Please get approved invoices to me by Thursday noon for this week's check run. Anything later goes next week.
note: A date in internal mail is somebody's calendar, not a response clock.

subject: Harbor View estimate review
body: Moving the Harbor View estimate review to Tuesday the 29th, 1 pm in the conference room. Mike, I will have the sub coverage sheet ready.

subject: Truss photos
body: Dave, can you grab photos of the building 4 trusses when they land? Sarah will want them for the draw.

subject: Truck 3
body: Truck 3 is in the shop for brakes. Use the flatbed tomorrow, keys are in the trailer.

subject: Fwd: correction notice, BP-26-1140
body:
Mike, forwarding this one from the city. They want the revised grading certification within 10 business days of this notice or the next inspection gets held. The notice is dated today.

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: City of Easton Building Division
Subject: Correction notice, BP-26-1140
Submit a revised grading certification signed by the civil engineer.
note: An authority's window carried by an internal forward. It is team mail, so it goes to no one as a topic, but the clock still reaches Mike. The notice is dated the day of the forward, so counting from the forward is right.

subject: Hose bib quantities
body: Erin, I need the hose bib count per building for CO-2604-08 so I can finish the number. Oakline's layout would do.
note: Team mail that names an open change order: the register's pricing window runs, so the clock is real even though the mail is internal.

subject: Cedar Ridge buyer walk
body: Mike, heads up: Sarah says the unit 2 buyer walk is on or before October 3. Not our deadline, but let's have the punch list closed before then.
note: Internal mail relaying an owner's sales date. A dated phrase parses, but team mail carries no clock of its own.
